playlist_ids = [224,227,226]
results = {}
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    total_sec = sum(s['duration'] for s in pl['songs'])
    results[pid] = {
        'title': pl['title'],
        'total_sec': total_sec,
        'total_min': total_sec/60,
        'num_songs': len(pl['songs'])
    }
    print(pid, pl['title'], 'songs', len(pl['songs']), 'total_sec', total_sec, 'total_min', total_sec/60)
print('done')
print(results)

access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2FuaXRhLmJ1cmNoQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.N6gOHoE_vN0n6L-X3W2q46RQIsuXaKuahNBpHjjppQI'

print('playlist_ids', playlist_ids)
all_stats=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    total_sec = sum(s['duration'] for s in pl['songs'])
    total_min = total_sec/60
    all_stats.append((pid, pl['title'], total_min, total_sec, len(pl['songs'])))

all_stats_sorted = sorted(all_stats, key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
print('stats_sorted')
for row in all_stats_sorted:
    print(row)
longest_min = all_stats_sorted[0][2]
rounded = int(round(longest_min))
print('longest_min', longest_min, 'rounded', rounded)
